content.passage: Saturday is Mai's birthday. Her friends want to celebrate, but it is a secret. Mai is a little sad because nobody says "Happy birthday" in the morning. She is bored at home. In the evening, Linh calls her: "Come to the café, please." When Mai arrives, all her friends are there: Nam, Tom, Anna and Mr. Long. "Surprise!" they shout. Mai is very surprised and happy. Nam is funny and dances on a chair. Mrs. Rosa brings a big cake. "Thank you for inviting me to my own party!" Mai laughs.
content.question: Whose birthday is it?

exercises.hint: Đọc lại câu chuyện "Bữa tiệc bất ngờ".

guideText:
Mẫu câu chính: "Why are you sad?" (Sao bạn buồn?) — "Nam is taller than Tom." (Nam cao hơn Tom.) — "Happy birthday!" (Chúc mừng sinh nhật!)
So sánh hơn với tính từ ngắn: thêm -er + than: tall → taller than, young → younger than, smart → smarter than.
Tính từ cảm xúc đuôi -ed mô tả cảm giác của người: I am bored, I am excited, She was surprised.
Giới từ đi kèm: afraid of (sợ), worried about (lo về), excited about (háo hức về).
Lời khuyên nhẹ nhàng: "Don't be sad." (Đừng buồn.)
